children: PMGC Holdings Inc. disclosed a 21.43% stake in NorthStrive Acquisition Corp I. through its control of NorthStrive Sponsor I LLC. The filing was made on Sep. 29, 2026. The position includes Class A shares and Class B shares that convert into Class A upon a business combination.

PMGC holds the stake for investment and plans to "engage in discussions with the issuer's management, board of directors, stockholders, and other interested parties concerning potential strategic transactions," including mergers or acquisitions.
The firm is "in discussions with third parties," but it states there are "no definitive agreements" in place and it may facilitate introductions for possible deals.

PMGC Holdings Inc. is a Nevada-based diversified holding company that focuses on acquiring and growing operating businesses across multiple industries. The company invests opportunistically and seeks value creation through strategic transactions and operational improvements. PMGC oversees the sponsor entity that directly holds the NorthStrive shares.
